text: A pickpocket brushes past him near {PLACE}.
say: His wallet is lighter.

guard.say: He feels the hand and grabs his wallet back.

text: A crowded tram stop by {PLACE}.
say: Someone lifted a few notes from his pocket.

guard.say: He keeps a hand on his pocket the whole time.

text: A thief tries to cut his bike lock outside {PLACE}.
say: He gets the bike back from the pound, for a fee.

guard.say: He shouts and the thief runs.

text: A warden is writing tickets on the street by {PLACE}.
say: One is for him.

text: A sudden downpour at {PLACE}.
say: He's soaked to the bone.

text: Something he ate at {PLACE} was off.
say: He spends a while looking for a toilet.

text: Someone bumps into him at {PLACE}.
say: Coffee all down his shirt.

text: A pigeon flies over {PLACE}.
say: Right on his head. Some say it's lucky.

text: His bag was open the whole walk to {PLACE}.
say: Something fell out on the way.

text: A man by {PLACE} plays the shell game with three cups.
say: He was sure it was the middle one.

guard.say: He's seen this trick before and walks on.

text: A loose cobble outside {PLACE}.
say: He twists his ankle.

guard.say: He stumbles but keeps his feet.

text: A nail on the road by {PLACE}.
say: A flat tyre, and a repair bill.

text: Everyone at {PLACE} is sneezing.
say: By evening, so is he.

text: A seagull eyes his snack near {PLACE}.
say: Gone in one swoop.

guard.say: He holds on tight and the gull gives up.

text: The bill at {PLACE} has a few extras on it.
say: He pays it anyway.

guard.say: He talks them out of it with a smile.

text: His phone slips out of his hand at {PLACE}.
say: A cracked screen, fixed at a kiosk.

text: His dragon sneezes outside {PLACE}.
say: He pays for a singed awning.

text: A stray dog follows him from {PLACE}.
say: It trots along for a while, then wanders home.

text: A wedding is spilling out of {PLACE}.
say: They wave him in for cake and a dance.

text: It's quiz night at {PLACE}.
say: His team wins by one point.

text: A note blows across the square by {PLACE}.
say: Nobody claims it.

text: A stall by {PLACE} hands out free samples.
say: He has three.

text: Tourists at {PLACE} ask him to take their photo.
say: They love it and he's in the next one.

text: A stranger at {PLACE} pays for his drink.
say: Just because.

text: A rainbow over {PLACE}.
say: He stops to watch it fade.

text: A street musician by {PLACE} asks him to sing along.
Someone at {PLACE} thinks he's an old school friend.
say: He plays along and gets a free lunch.

text: He finds an unscratched ticket near {PLACE}.
say: A small win.

text: A street party is starting outside {PLACE}.
say: He dances until his feet hurt.

text: A crying kid near {PLACE} has lost their parents.

options.label: Helps
options.say: he finds the parents two streets away.

options.label: Finds a guard
options.say: a guard takes it from there.

text: An old man at {PLACE} wants a game of chess.

options.label: Plays
options.say: he loses well and learns an opening.

text: A shopkeeper at {PLACE} is closing down.
say: Everything half price; he saves a bit.

text: The sun goes down behind {PLACE}.
say: He sits on a step and watches.

text: A local at {PLACE} tells him where the best food in town is.
say: He makes a note.

text: Kids at {PLACE} spot his flying carpet.
say: He gives short rides for a few coins.

text: A mime outside {PLACE} copies his every step.
say: He walks backwards for a bit to confuse him.

text: A tourist at {PLACE} asks him the way.

options.label: Guesses
options.say: he points confidently. It was wrong.

text: A cat at {PLACE} stares at him.
say: He stares back. He loses.

text: A film crew is shooting by {PLACE}.
say: He walks through the back of a shot. Twice.

text: A living statue at {PLACE} winks at him.
say: He drops a coin in the hat.

text: An old lady at {PLACE} hands him a bag of breadcrumbs.
say: Forty pigeons arrive at once.

text: A man at {PLACE} wears the exact same outfit.
say: They nod at each other, very seriously.

text: A fortune teller near {PLACE} reads his palm.
say: She says he'll travel. He nods.

text: A brass band marches past {PLACE}.
say: He follows it for a block without meaning to.

text: A family of ducks crosses the road by {PLACE}.
say: All traffic stops and so does he.

text: A bearded man at {PLACE} asks him what it all means.

options.label: Answers
options.say: they talk for an hour and agree on nothing.

options.label: Shrugs
options.say: the man seems satisfied with that.

text: A school trip at {PLACE} spots his tortoise.
say: Thirty kids want a photo with it.

text: A woman at {PLACE} asks where he got his broom.
say: He says it was his grandmother's.

text: An old painted sign over {PLACE} still says 1923.
say: He wonders who painted it.

text: An influencer at {PLACE} asks him to hold her phone.
say: Twenty takes later she's happy.

text: The waiter at {PLACE} brings him the wrong dish.
say: He eats it anyway. It's better.
